scope: Development mechanism diagnostic only; seven necessary conditions, not a complete acceptance audit
interpretation: The quadratic identity is exact for fixed physical/model signed outputs and matching targets; serialized statistics are rounded.

numerical_bound.why_conservative: Pessimistic sequential float32 reduction; also applied to the more accurate float64 model/energy statistics.
numerical_bound.science_limit_error: factor*epsilon_B+1e-9 e2; additionally allows numerical uncertainty in the frozen physical reference
numerical_bound.outer_interval: Solve q<=epsilon with strict boundaries closed, then expand roots by 1e-20 in lambda and intersect [0,1]
numerical_bound.limits: An arithmetic bound for matching sufficient statistics; it does not cover corrupted inputs, a changed model, or re-inversion differences.
